Hi Katie — quick follow-up and a few small activation tips to help you burn down the credit window while collecting meaningful signals:

1) Prioritize short, batched tests — use the streaming endpoint for lower latency and to avoid repeated full-context costs. Try a 5–10 prompt job that simulates production traffic rather than many single-shot calls.
2) Use prefix-caching for repeated system messages (we can share a small SDK snippet) — that cuts token cost per session by up to ~35%.
3) Set a temporary higher per-route concurrency in Console for 24–48 hours so your infra can run more parallel jobs. I can toggle this for you if you prefer.

If you’d like an activation sprint, Neha from CS can run a 45-minute pairing session to:
- wire up request shaping to your infra
- demonstrate prefix caching and streaming settings
- deliver a 3-prompt evaluation harness you can run repeatedly

Proposed slots: 2026-04-26 10:00am PT, 2026-04-27 2:00pm PT, 2026-04-28 11:00am PT. Pick one and I’ll lock Neha in.

If it helps, I can also increase the per-route concurrency for 48 hours starting on the chosen date so your teams can blast through the smoke tests without throttling.

Let me know — we want you to get real signal before the credit expires.

Thanks,
Vanessa
